en.name: Witch
en.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
en.flavor: Three drops of goat's blood. A lock of hair, torn in anger. The name is spoken, the shadow cast. Walk left foot first down that brambled path, and don't look back.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.

zh.name: 女巫
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择一名玩家：如果他明天白天发起提名，他死亡。如果只有三名存活的玩家，你失去此能力。
